items.source: beanKey - the key associated with the MBean in the beans map of the MBeanExporter
items.translation: beanKey - beans 映射中与 MBeanExporter 中的 MBean 关联的键

items.source: You can supply an array of method names via the ignoredMethods property. If you have multiple beans and you wish each bean to use a different set of method names, then you can map bean keys (that is the name used to pass the bean to the MBeanExporter) to a list of method names using the ignoredMethodMappings property.
items.translation: 您可以通过 `ignoredMethods` 属性提供方法名数组。如果您有多个 Bean，并希望每个 Bean 使用不同的方法名集合，则可以使用 `ignoredMethodMappings` 属性将 Bean 键（即用于向 `MBeanExporter` 传递 Bean 的名称）映射到方法名列表。

items.source: If you specify values for both ignoredMethodMappings and ignoredMethods, Spring will attempt to find method names in the mappings first. If no method names for the bean are found, it will use the method names defined by ignoredMethods.
items.translation: 如果您同时为 `ignoredMethodMappings` 和 `ignoredMethods` 指定了值，Spring 将首先在映射中查找方法名。如果未找到该 Bean 的方法名，它将使用由 `ignoredMethods` 定义的方法名。

items.source: These method names will be used for a bean if no entry corresponding to that bean is found in the ignoredMethodsMappings property.
items.translation: 如果未在 `ignoredMethodsMappings` 属性中找到与该 Bean 对应的条目，则将使用这些方法名。

items.source: These method names are ignored when creating the management interface.
items.translation: 这些方法名称在创建管理接口时会被忽略。

items.source:
Any method not explicitly excluded from the management interface will be exposed to
JMX. JavaBean getters and setters will automatically be exposed as JMX attributes.
items.translation: 任何未从管理接口中明确排除的方法都将暴露给 JMX。JavaBean 的 getter 和 setter 将自动作为 JMX 属性进行暴露。

items.source:
The property key must match the bean key and the property value must match
the list of method names. When searching for method names to ignore for a bean,
Spring will check these mappings first.
items.translation: 属性键必须与 Bean 键匹配，且属性值必须与方法名列表匹配。在搜索要忽略的 Bean 方法名时，Spring 将首先检查这些映射。
